notes: Cash basis county; all funds governmental (no proprietary funds). Statement receipts from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds (p4); the Taxes line 5,016,998 is split using the Statement of Activities general receipts breakdown (p2): property general 3,039,224 + property debt service 766,949 + motor vehicle 430,011 + inheritance 780,814 = 5,016,998. Charges for services 630,960 kept as printed (SoA shows 537,988 program charges + 92,972 other local receipts). Public Works 52,600 is the General Fund Noxious Weed department (natural resources/conservation). Nonmajor transfers 24,491 (911 Wireless to Central Communications) net to zero in the Total column; no governmental transfers. Balance sheet from Exhibit C governmental funds Total column (totals equal the Statement of Net Position, p1). Detail: budget schedules for General (pp5-10), Road/Bridge (p11), Inheritance Tax (p12), Debt Service (p13) and nonmajor funds by fund (pp14-16); the combining schedule (p17) is not recorded separately (same funds, less detail). Lines with no actual amount (Election Commissioner/Clerk of District Court/Sheriff capital outlay, Surveyor, etc.) are omitted. General and Road/Bridge 'Taxes' stay taxes (unlabeled): motor vehicle and property cannot be separated by fund. Debt Service Fund Taxes = SoA 'Property taxes, levied for debt service' exactly. Central Communications Taxes kept unlabeled. Read pages 1-17 of 17
